Every time you buy bacon, ribs, or pork chops, some of that money may ultimately help fund one of Big Pork’s most powerful lobbying groups. 

A new analysis of financial documents obtained by Vox found that since the early 2000s, the National Pork Board — which legally can’t use its funds for lobbying — has moved $66 million into the National Pork Producers Council, a lobbying organization. 

Read the full story: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/499438/pork-checkoff-usda-board-producers-council

What is the untold truth behind this mysterious ancient egyptian carving?

An intriguing scene carved into an ancient Egyptian wall shows two figures facing each other while holding a mysterious central object. The unusual shape of the object has sparked curiosity about what it could represent and why it was placed between the figures.

Is it a symbolic religious object, a ceremonial item, or something with a meaning we no longer fully understand? The surrounding hieroglyphs may provide important clues.

Explore this fascinating ancient carving and decide for yourself what this mysterious scene might have meant.
.
.
.
 #ancientegypt #Egypt #mysterious #AncientMystery #archaeology
